cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.

mechanism: A teaches proper planning to enlist B in a possible better outcome despite weak evidence.
confusable: Blind confidence alone differs from involving B in imagining and working toward the hopeful outcome.
comparison: A parade has a marginal route and one potential spectator; a cafe waitlist has imaginary future customers.
seedUse: Use the loading-bay and cafe seeds but make correction shape shared hope rather than adorn it.
